# Design In Mental Health Network (DiMHN)

> > A UK charity advancing mental health recovery through evidence-based design standards, research, and collaborative practice since 2006.

DiMHN is a leading organization dedicated to improving mental health environments through rigorous design principles and lived experience co-production. The network brings together architects, healthcare professionals, researchers, and people with lived experience to develop therapeutic spaces and design guidance that support recovery.

## Key Topics

- Mental health design
- Therapeutic environments
- Design standards
- Lived experience
- Co-production
- Evidence-based design
- Healthcare design
- Sensory-informed design
- Design with People in Mind
- Informed Choices testing
- Environmental design
- Professional development
- Design guidance
- Mental health facilities

## About DiMHN

- [About the Design in Mental Health Network (DiMHN)](https://dimhn.org/about-the-design-in-mental-health-network-dimhn): UK charity improving mental health environments through design since 2006
- [Board and Associates](https://dimhn.org/board-and-associates): Leadership team and board members driving DiMHN's mission forward
- [Partners](https://dimhn.org/partners): Partnership opportunities for collaboration, research, and innovation
- [Work with the Design In Mental Health Network](https://dimhn.org/about-the-design-in-mental-health-network-dimhn/work-with-dimhn): Job and volunteer opportunities including Board Trustee positions

## Core Projects & Standards

- [Active Projects](https://dimhn.org/active-projects): Overview of DiMHN's ongoing work in design standards and research
- [Design with People in Mind](https://dimhn.org/dwpim): Annual flagship publication of research and evidence for design excellence
- [Informed Choices testing standard](https://dimhn.org/informed-choices): DiMHN's formal testing standard for mental health products and safety
- [Environmental Hub](https://dimhn.org/active-projects/environmental-hub): Open-access resource for designing therapeutic mental health environments
- [Research and Education](https://dimhn.org/active-projects/research-and-education): Evidence-based resources and best practices for mental health design

## Learning & Engagement

- [DIMHN Webinars](https://dimhn.org/active-projects/webinars): Educational webinars on mental health design topics and evidence-based practice
- [Lighting in Mental Health Webinar](https://dimhn.org/active-projects/webinars/mental-health-lighting-webinar): Free webinar on lighting science and standards in mental health settings
- [Sensory-Informed Design in Practice](https://dimhn.org/active-projects/webinars/brook-webinar-sensory-informed-design): Webinar insights on sensory-informed design in inpatient mental health units
- [Social Investment & Mental Health Spaces](https://dimhn.org/active-projects/webinars/mental-health-social-finance-webinar): Webinar on social investment approaches for mental health facilities
- [Membership Engagement](https://dimhn.org/active-projects/membership-engagement): DiMHN membership benefits, networking, and professional development
- [The Network magazine](https://dimhn.org/the-network): Premium magazine featuring news, opinions, and design insights for members

## Membership & Resources

- [Resources](https://dimhn.org/resources): Member-exclusive publications, frameworks, and design guidance resources
- [Choose A Subscription](https://dimhn.org/plans/choose-a-subscription): Membership subscription plans and pricing options for DiMHN
- [Find A Specialist](https://dimhn.org/find-a-specialist): Directory of architects, suppliers, and specialists in mental health design

## Global Expansion

- [International Work](https://dimhn.org/active-projects/international-work): DiMHN's global expansion and partnerships in North America and Europe
